_comment:
'Combo - If Open the Center was the last attack this combat chain, Fluster Fist gains +1{p} for each attack that has hit this combat chain.'

Shape copied verbatim from shipped wtr/blackout_kick_blue.json (same Combo wording): TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK + LAST_CHAIN_ATTACK by printed name - never the COMBO type, which reads a names LIST and gates on empty (DSL_REFERENCE). The name matches every colour printing of Open the Center (colour suffix stripped before compare, condition_types.py:1658-1670). An Action - Attack card is TRIGGERED/ON_ATTACK, never ATTACK_REACTION.

AMOUNT: COUNT_CHAIN_LINKS with hit=true - the handler reads talent/class/subtype/hit (effect_types.py:205-224), and at ON_ATTACK time chain_links holds only PRIOR links (a link is appended after its damage resolves, per the LAST_CHAIN_ATTACK handler comment), so 'each attack that has hit this combat chain' counts exactly the earlier hits and correctly excludes Fluster Fist itself, which has not resolved yet.

KNOWN APPROXIMATION: COUNT_CHAIN_LINKS counts only links whose attacker is this card's controller (effect_types.py:213 skips link.attacker_id != pid). The printed text counts ANY attack that has hit this combat chain, which would include an opponent's attack-reaction hit earlier in the chain; such a hit undercounts by one. Ninja chains are overwhelmingly your own links, so the practical divergence is narrow - flagged rather than worked around (no expression counts opposing links).

Combo in printed_keywords fires from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored.
